name: Gencatrol Tramadol 50mg — 60 Capsules
short: Gencatrol® tramadol 50 mg, 60 capsules — centrally-acting opioid analgesic for moderate to moderately severe pain. Available with prescription verification at CMC Pharmacy Cabo.
description:
Gencatrol® is the Mexican brand of tramadol 50 mg, a centrally-acting analgesic indicated for the management of moderate to moderately severe pain in adults. Each capsule contains tramadol hydrochloride 50 mg, and this presentation includes 60 capsules.

Tramadol binds to opioid receptors and also inhibits the reuptake of serotonin and norepinephrine, producing analgesic effects. Treatment should be individualized; do not exceed the prescribed dose or combine with alcohol or other CNS depressants without medical supervision. Tramadol is a controlled medication in many jurisdictions, including Mexico. Consult your healthcare provider for appropriate dosing and duration of therapy.

Available at CMC Pharmacy Cabo with bilingual service and fast hotel delivery throughout the Cabo region. Prescription Required. A valid controlled-substance prescription is needed to dispense this medication. CMC Pharmacy Cabo verifies prescriptions per Mexican regulations (NOM-073-SSA1).
